result.title: Sub-actions in Action: Text-Guided Hand-Role Alignment for Sub-Action Recognition
result.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026, Supplementary material is available
result.summary: Our objective is to enhance VLMs ability to distinguish the roles of the left and right hands in egocentric actions. We introduce sub-action detection, a task that requires models to explicitly recognise the left- and right-hand roles and their manipulated objects within an ongoing high-level action. To address this challenge, we propose BiScopeNet, a framework that augments existing video-LLMs without modifying their vision encoders or language models. BiScopeNet incorporates two components: FocusAlign, a gated text-guided attention-based module that selectively aligns video features with textual context to emphasise action-relevant cues, and MetaLoss, a masked, object-weighted loss that prioritises visually grounded terms. To supervise sub-action detection, we introduce BiScopeCap-100K, a large-scale video-level dataset curated from existing egocentric datasets, providing dense captions that jointly describe high-level actions, left/right-hand roles, and manipulated objects, enriched with spatial metadata for grounding. Across the evaluated Video-LLM backbones, BiScopeNet improves action, hand-role, and object recognition over the corresponding supervised baselines, achieving the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated configurations on BiScopeCap.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出子动作检测任务，构建含左右手角色与操作对象密集描述的 BiScopeCap-100K 数据集，并设计 BiScopeNet：以门控文本引导注意力模块（FocusAlign）筛选动作相关视觉线索，配合按对象加权的掩码损失（MetaLoss）增强视频 LLM 的角色与物体识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其门控文本引导的视觉特征筛选与按对象加权的监督，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和贡献分配提供方法线索；但论文聚焦自我中心动作识别，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接关系，需核查其注意力门控是否真能保留细粒度视觉信息。
